subject: DataLink AWS listing intake — security, metering, and billing questions
messages:
From: Sara Bell <sara@datalink.io>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 10 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AWS marketplace listing & sell-with — intake

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the quick intro last week — appreciate you taking time. DataLink is ready to start the AWS marketplace listing process and we want to align on the technical and commercial evidence you need for a smooth listing + sell-with/co-sell pairing. High level asks from our side: get a sense for the expected timeline and any blockers so we can prioritize.

To help, can you confirm what you need up front? Our draft list (happy to expand):
- SOC 2 Type II summary + auditor contact (if required)
- Network architecture diagram showing where customer traffic flows and any data-plane integrations with Redwood
- Metering endpoints / usage-reporting spec (how your catalogue expects metered usage to be reported)
- Suggested SKU/pricing mapping for a co-sell entitlements model
- Any seller-of-record or reseller paperwork (we may need a marketplace MPA/POA)

We can share artifacts — I can attach a short SOC2 summary and a network diagram in my next email. Proposed timeline: intake -> evidence review (2 weeks) -> entitlements & pricing mapping (1 week) -> legal signoff & DocuSign (1–2 weeks). Is that realistic for Redwood?

Would love to include a short sandbox test account so we can validate metering events end-to-end. If there's a marketplace intake form you prefer, send it over and we'll fill it.

Looking forward —
Sara
Sara Bell
Head of Partnerships, DataLink Inc
(sara@datalink.io)
From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
To: Sara Bell <sara@datalink.io>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 10 May 2025 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS marketplace listing & sell-with — intake

Sara — thanks, this is a great starter list. We can move quickly if DataLink supplies the artifacts. Quick answers up front:

- SOC2: summary is fine for intake; legal may request the auditor contact during review.
- Network diagram: yes, please include the diagram with annotated customer data flows. We specifically look for any egress to third parties and where keys are managed.
- Metering: we use an event-based metering model for AWS catalog listings. We need a sample of your metering payloads (timestamps, account ids, sku_id, usage_amount) and a sample CSV export of daily rolls for the last 7 days if available.
- SKUs: attach a suggested SKU mapping and indicate which SKUs are eligible for sell-with entitlements (percentage-based revshare) vs. standard listing.
- Legal: we run a standard marketplace MPA; DocuSign flow is typical.

Action items (owners in parens):
1) DataLink to provide: SOC2 summary, network diagram, metering payload spec + sample roll CSV, SKU/pricing spreadsheet (Sara)
2) Redwood intake review: marketplace ops (Olga) for metering, commercial (Ben) for SKU/revshare, alliances (Vivek) for go-to-market plan (Jonas)
3) Legal redline: we will route to legal once artifacts look good (estimated 3–5 business days)

Send the artifacts to this thread and include any DocuSign MPA link if you have one. If you can provide the sandbox/test account credentials (or a read-only token) we can validate metering within 48 hours of receiving samples.

Thanks — I'll schedule a 30-min sync next week if that helps.

Jonas Weber
Director, Cloud Alliances | Redwood Inference
From: Sara Bell <sara@datalink.io>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: Matt Chen <matt.chen@acme-corp.com>
Date: Mon, 12 May 2025 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS marketplace listing & sell-with — intake

Thanks Jonas — attaching the initial artifacts per the intake list. Attachments (stubs): datalink-soc2-summary.pdf, datalink-network-arch.png, metering-endpoints-specs.yaml, datalink-pricing-sku-proposal.xlsx.

Notes on metering: our endpoints emit an event for each usage unit; the attached YAML shows the payload shape and the optional batching header for bulk uploads. We can also provide a daily CSV roll (sample) — attaching a 7-day sample as requested. For sandbox validation, we can spin up a read-only API key that allows you to push test events to the sandbox collector. I'll include credentials in a follow-up secure message (or we can add them to a shared S3 with limited access).

On SKUs: we proposed two SKUs for co-sell (datalink-core-hourly and datalink-premium-seat) — pricing sheet includes suggested unit price and a recommended revshare split (15% sell-with). If Redwood prefers a flat per-seat billing model, we can map.

DocuSign: we have a marketplace MPA ready — here's the link for your review: https://www.docusign.com/12345/MPA-DATALINK (ATTACHMENT: MPA-DATALINK-draft.pdf).

Let me know if someone from engineering should join the sync to walk the metering payloads.

Best,
Sara
From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 May 2025 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: DataLink AWS listing & sell-with — intake

Forwarding DataLink artifacts — see attachments. Short internal plan below; please reply with availability and notes.

Internal action items / timeline proposal:
- Olga: validate metering payloads against our marketplace ingestion schema and confirm if the batching header is compatible with our collector (ETA: 48 hours). Attachments to review: metering-endpoints-specs.yaml, sample-roll-7days.csv.
- Ben: review SKU/pricing spreadsheet and flag any SKU name collisions with existing catalog items — also propose revenue-share tiers and whether we should require a minimum commitment (ETA: 3 business days).
- Vivek: coordinate GTM/sell-with pitch — identify two pilot accounts we can co-sell into and prepare a short co-sell one-pager (ETA: 1 week).
- Jonas (me): coordinate legal intake and request the DocuSign MPA for redline. I'll ask Legal to prioritize once Olga signs off on metering.

Two quick notes: 1) if legal asks for the SOC2 auditor contact, we should ask Sara to provide that immediately, and 2) if metering requires any schema changes on our side we should scope a small engineering spike (1-2 days).
